Shopify Multivendor Marketplace- Feature Apps Upgraded

Multivendor Marketplace is an ultimate tool to convert your shop into a fully-functioning marketplace. Through this, you can add sellers to your online store and keep track of their sales.

Within this app, we have introduced numerous "Feature Apps" that provide additional benefits to the admin as well as to the sellers.

These feature apps are divided into multiple categories as per their functionalities.

As soon as you install the app, you need to visit the "Feature Apps" section of your store and activate it from your end.

On the upper right corner of the admin dashboard, you will get the "three dots". You can click on it to visit the "Feature Apps" section of the app.

Let's go through the Multivendor Marketplace Feature Apps one by one based on the categories.

Marketplace Shipping Feature Apps

Here is the list of all the shipping feature apps available for the marketplace:-

SHIPPING

Multivendor Marketplace Shipping enables the admin to configure the shipping method from his end for the seller and

the sellers will configure the shipping methods on the basis of the price and weight of the product.

This feature also allows sellers to add shipping range for products, add countries, enable/disable states as well as shipping methods from their end.

If you want to get access to this shipping feature, you need to choose the Shopify store plan which supports “Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping”.

Important Note:- This Shipping feature is available in the Pro Plan ($60 USD) of the Multivendor App.

There is no need to pay an additional charge to install this feature app.

EXPLORE

USPS Shipping

Currently, the USPS App is not available (depreciated).

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace USPS Shipping feature is now integrated with stamp.com. This feature helps the admin to allow his/her sellers to ship their products using USPS.

Also, You can allow your sellers to generate Shipping Labels automatically for the fulfilled orders using Stamp.

Please Note:- It is necessary for the admin to have an account on Stamp.com and these stamp details further help the admin to configure USPS details.

This feature app costs $10 USD per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

Important Note:- To make the feature app work, the admin needs to choose the Shopify Store Plan which supports “Real-Time Carrier Calculated Shipping”.

Refer to the USER MANUAL to know more about this feature app.

POST NL

The Multi-vendor Marketplace comes up with another shipping feature app here namely PostNL Shipping.

The admin can allow sellers to manage the order fulfillment via PostNL and automatically generate shipping labels for the orders.

Note:- To make the Post NL feature app work, it is mandatory to have “Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping” enabled on your Shopify store.

Kindly contact Shopify support if you face any concerns in enabling the "Real-Time Carrier - Calculated Shipping".

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 10 over and above your current multivendor plan.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

J&T EXPRESS

The Multi-vendor Marketplace comes up with another shipping feature app here namely J&T Express.

The admin can allow sellers to manage the order fulfillment via J&T Express and automatically generate shipping labels for the orders.

NOTE:- This J&T Express shipping feature app is available only with the Multivendor ProPlan ($60/month).

Moreover, you need to enable the Shipping Add-on for FREE from the ‘Feature Apps’ section of the app.

Along with this, it is mandatory to enable "Real-Time-Carrier-Calculated Shipping" on your Shopify store.

Kindly contact Shopify support if you face any concerns in enabling the "Real-Time Carrier - Calculated Shipping".

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 10 over and above your current multivendor plan.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

ECOM EXPRESS SHIPPING

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Ecom Express Shipping feature allows both admin and seller to manage the fulfillment.

Once the customer places an order, the seller can directly fulfill it from the backend with this feature app.

If the order is fulfilled, the seller can “Edit Tracking” as well as set the delivery status of the order.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 10 over and above your current multivendor plan.

To know more about this feature, refer to its User Guide.

SHIPMONDO

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “SHIPMONDO” feature app is here.

Shipmondo: They help you ship goods worldwide across carriers from one platform.

Making it possible for you to offer different shipping options to your customers. Note that currently, we only support Postnord Shipping within Shipmondo.

Using this featured app, merchants can allow vendors to ship their goods via multiple carrier shipping methods and then print the shipping label.

Charges: This feature will have an additional charge of USD 10 per month over & above your current multivendor marketplace plan.

Before You Install: It is mandatory to have real-time carrier calculated shipping within your Shopify store.

This is a requirement defined by Shopify for your store to retrieve shipping rates from third-party sources, such as this shipping app.

This feature app is available only with the Multivendor Pro Plan ($60/month). Moreover, you need to enable the Shipping add-on (free) from the ‘featured apps’ section of the app.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

SENDLE

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “SENDLE” feature app is here.

The Sendle shipping is now integrated with the Multi-vendor Marketplace App for Shopify to let sellers fulfill their orders via Sendle shipment service and generate shipping labels.

This feature app costs you a minimal amount of $10 per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

NOTE:-

  • The Sendle shipping feature app is available only with the Multivendor Pro Plan ($60/month).
  • You need to enable the Shipping Add-on for FREE from the ‘Feature Apps’ section of the app.

Moreover, access to Shipping requires your Shopify store to be on the plan that supports Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

SWISSPOST

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “SWISSPOST” feature app is here.

By enabling the Swiss Post shipping featured app, the admin can allow sellers to manage the order fulfillment via Swiss Post shipping.

Also, automatically generate shipping labels for the orders.

This feature app will charge you a minimal amount of $10 per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

NOTE:- This Swiss Post shipping feature app is available only with the Multivendor Pro Plan ($60/month).

Moreover, you need to enable the Shipping Add-on for FREE from the ‘Feature Apps’ section of the app.

Also, Access to Shipping requires your Shopify store to be on the plan that supports Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping.

The Swiss post Shipping feature is compatible with the Partial Fulfillment feature.

SWISS POST FEATURE APP IS AVAILABLE ONLY FOR FULFILLMENT.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

DELHIVERY

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “DELHIVERY” feature app is here.

Delhivery: Delhivery Private Limited is India’s largest B2B & C2C Logistic Courier Service Provider in India.

They provide the fastest Parcel Transportation, Warehousing & more. Using this featured app,

merchants can allow vendors to ship their goods via Delhivery and then print the shipping label.

Charges: This feature will have an additional charge of USD 10 per month over & above your current multivendor marketplace plan.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

EASYPOST

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “EASYPOST” feature app is here.

EasyPost is known to be one of the most powerful shipping solutions to manage shipments.

The EasyPost API is now integrated with the Multi-vendor Marketplace app for Shopify.

Merchants can visit the Multi-vendor admin panel and enable the EasyPost shipping featured app. Thus, allow sellers to manage the order fulfillment via EasyPost API.

Also, automatically generate shipping labels of the orders.

This feature app will charge you a minimal amount of $10 per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

EASYSHIP

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “EASYSHIP” feature app is here.

E-commerce has become an essential part of our lives. Easyship has led to an increase in demand for shipping services.

From groceries to clothes and electronics, we can purchase almost everything online.

However, shipping can be a complex and time-consuming process, especially for small and medium-sized e-commerce businesses.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

SHIPROCKET

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “SHIPROCKET” feature app is here.

By enabling the Shiprocket shipping featured app,

the admin can allow the sellers to manage both the order fulfillment using the Shiprocket shipping and generate the shipping labels for the orders

This feature app comes will charge you $10 per month in addition to your current Multivendor plan.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

SBEEDY SHIPPING

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “SBEEDY SHIPPING” feature app is here.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 10 over and above your current multivendor plan.

CANADA POST SHIPPING

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace's “Canada Post Shipping” feature app is here.

It helps Canadian sellers to ship their products worldwide. Sellers can also generate “Shipping Labels” from their accounts on the Multivendor app.

Important Note:- To make this Canada Post feature work, it is mandatory to choose the Shopify store plan which supports the “Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping”.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 10 over and above your current multivendor plan.

Refer to the User Guide to know more about this feature.

STORE PICK UP

Using the Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Store Pickup feature app, the admin can allow his sellers to provide an order pickup option to the customers.

Through this, customers can pick up their ordered products from the seller’s store and avoid shipping rates.

Once the admin enables this feature on his/her end, the seller can enable the store pickup option that will be applicable to all Seller’s products.

The seller will provide his store address as the “Store Pickup Address”.

This feature app is at a monthly charge of $10 USD/month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

You can refer the USER GUIDE to know more about this app.

AIRSPEED SHIPPING

We came up with a new feature app named “AirSpeed Shipping” to manage fulfillment on a priority basis.

This feature app comes with an option to Notify the Courier about the prepared order to be shipped to the customers.

Using this feature app, both admin and sellers can notify the courier about the customer’s order from their respective panels.

Accordingly, sellers will manage the fulfillment of their seller panels and generate shipping labels for the fulfilled orders.

This feature App comes with a charge of $10 USD/month over and above your current multivendor plan.
You can refer the USER GUIDE to know more about this app.

AUSTRALIA POST SHIPPING

Australia Post, a government-owned corporation known to provide postal services in Australia. Now, we have integrated it with the Multi-vendor Marketplace app for Shopify.

Presenting Australia Post Feature app using which admin can allow the sellers to deliver their shipment via Australia Post shipment method and

can also Generate Shipping Labels from the app.

This feature will have an additional charge of USD 10 per month over and above your current multivendor plan.

Note:- To make Australia Post shipping feature work, you need to choose the Shopify store plan that supports the “Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping”.

You can refer the USER GUIDE to know more about this app.

UPS

Multi-vendor Marketplace app has come up with the UPS feature app to manage product shipping, track the packages &

print shipping labels through the United Parcel Service (UPS).

You can now visit the feature app section and enable the “UPS” feature app to let the sellers ship their products through UPS.

For this, you need to have a UPS account as you need your account details to configure UPS shipping in the app.

In addition to it, you can allow sellers to generate shipping labels of fulfilled orders through UPS.

This feature of the Multivendor app will charge you an additional amount of $10 USD per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

To make UPS shipping feature work, you need to choose the Shopify store plan which supports the “Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping”.

Important Note:- “UPS Feature is available only in the Multivendor PRO ($60/month) Plan + You need to enable the “Shipping” Feature App which is FREE of cost.”

You can refer the USER GUIDE to know more about this app.

FedEx

FedEx Corporation is an American multinational courier delivery service.

Using this featured app, the merchants can enable shipment through FedEx. Moreover, he can allow US sellers to automatically generate shipping labels.

FedEx feature app is available only with the Multivendor PRO Plan ($60/month). Moreover, you need to enable the Shipping add-on (free) from feature apps section of the app.

CHARGES: This feature will have an additional charge of USD 10 per month over & above your current MVM plan.

NOTE: Above all, access to Shipping requires your Shopify store to be on the plan that supports Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping.

Currently, the FedEx Shipping feature app will only work for the US Merchants.
You can refer the USER GUIDE to know more about this app.

VAMASHIP

Vamaship is a SaaS enabled logistics marketplace. Besides, it facilitates shipping via air, ocean, and surface to over 200 countries and 26,000 pin codes within India.

Using this featured app, the merchants can enable shipment through Vamaship. Moreover, he can automatically generate shipping labels for the same.

Vamaship feature app is available only with the Multivendor PRO Plan ($60/month).

Moreover, you need to enable the Shipping add-on (free) from feature apps section of the app.

CHARGES: This feature will have an additional charge of USD 10 per month over & above your current MVM plan.

NOTE: Above all, access to Shipping requires your Shopify store to be on the plan that supports Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping.

You can refer the USER GUIDE to know more about this app.

BLUEDART

Blue Dart is integrated with the very popular Multi-vendor Marketplace App for Shopify. So, you can now allow sellers to fulfill orders via Blue Dart fulfillment & courier delivery services.

Additionally, allow sellers to generate shipping labels for fulfilled orders.

This feature of the Multivendor app will charge you a minimal amount of $10 per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

Note:- The Split Cart feature of the app is compatible with this shipping feature app.

Points to be Noted

  • “Blue Dart Feature is available only in the Multivendor PRO ($60/month) Plan + You need to enable the “Shipping” Feature App which is FREE of cost.”
  • Please make sure that it is necessary for admin to have an account on Blue Dart. These Blue Dart account details will help the admin to configure settings in the app.
  • Please Note:- To make this feature work, you need to choose the Shopify store plan which supports the “Real-Time Carrier-Calculated Shipping”.
  • Make the Contact Number, a mandatory field for the customers for checkout.

You can refer the USER GUIDE to know more about this app.

SHIPSTATION

ShipStation feature app allows you to ship your goods via multiple carrier shipping methods & generate shipping labels of the orders.

For more detail, please refer to the User Guide.

Envia Shipping

Multi-Vendor Marketplace for Shopify is here with another marketplace shipping feature app, i.e., Envia Shipping.

Using this featured app, the merchants can enable shipment through Envia. Moreover, he can allow sellers to automatically generate shipping labels.

Bring Shipping

Using Bring Shipping featured app, the merchants can allow sellers to ship goods through the Bring shipping method and then print Shipping Label. Moreover, create a pickup request.

DHL Express

Using DHL Express featured app, the merchants can allow sellers to ship your goods through DHL using multiple carrier shipping methods and then print Shipping Label.

SWISS POST

The Multi-vendor Marketplace has introduced another shipping feature app for order fulfillment named Swiss Post i.e. the national postal service of Switzerland.

By enabling the Swiss Post shipping featured app, the admin can allow sellers to manage the order fulfillment via Swiss Post shipping.

Also, automatically generate shipping labels for the orders.

This feature app will charge you a minimal amount of $10 per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

Along with this, it is mandatory to enable "Real-Time-Carrier-Calculated Shipping" on your Shopify store.

Kindly contact Shopify support if you face any concerns in enabling the "Real-Time Carrier - Calculated Shipping".

Refer to the user guide for more information on the Swiss Post feature application

MARKETPLACE SELLER FEATURE APPS

Here is the list of all the seller add-ons available for the marketplace:-

SELLER BUYER CHAT

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace SELLER BUYER CHAT feature app.

Using this integration, you can display a live chat widget on your storefront. The customers can connect with the sellers on the runtime and get their queries resolved.

Go through the User Manual to know more about this feature app.

SOCIAL NETWORK TABS

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace SOCIAL NETWORK TABS feature app.

Admin can enable his/her sellers to connect their seller profile page with their own social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Digg, Flickr, Vimeo, etc.

This feature will have an additional cost of USD 5 per month which is over and above your current Multivendor Marketplace plan.

Go through the User Manual to know more about this feature app.

SELLER TAGS AND CATEGORIES

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace SELLER TAGS AND CATEGORIES feature app.

Using this featured app, the vendors will be able to choose tags & categories for themselves added by the admin. Further, these can be used as filters on the storefront.

This feature will have an additional charge of USD 5 per month over & above your current Multivendor Marketplace plan.

Go through the User Manual to know more about this feature app.

ASK A QUESTION

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Ask a Question feature app.

It enables the customers to ask questions related to the product directly with the seller of that product even before purchasing the product.

Both admin and seller can answer the question asked by the customer. Admin can view the whole conversation of Seller and buyer.

Once you enable this feature, you will add 15 USD per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.

Go through the User Manual to know more about this feature app.

Seller Membership

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Seller Membership feature.

It enables the store owner to create plans and seller needs to subscribe the plan if he/she wants to publish his/her products in the shopify store of the admin.

Admin will charge this membership fee from his seller within this feature app.

To get this feature installed in your Multivendor app, click on enable button in “Feature Apps” section.

Once clicked, you need to pay the monthly charge of USD 25 over and above your current Multivendor plan.

To know more about this feature, do refer this User Guide.

Seller Vacation App

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Seller Vacation App is here to provide the information to the admin as well as to the buyer about the unavailability of the seller

so that they can manage the purchase accordingly.

If the seller is unavailable to fulfill the order, he can either disable all his products or he can continue selling with a message display for the customers.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 5 over and above your current multivendor plan.

Refer the User Guide to know more about this feature app.

PWA for Sellers

Multivendor Marketplace App for Shopify is here with another feature app called PWA which lets you enable progressive web application functionality for your marketplace sellers.

Using this featured app, the admin can send different kinds of push notifications to his sellers. The notifications can be automatic as well as manual.

NOTE: PWA Feature App is only available for stores with Custom Seller Domain (with SSL).

Seller and customer badge

Using this application, you can create & assign multiple seller and customer badges on your marketplace.

Customers can see the seller badges assigned badges on the shop/seller profile page and Vendors can see them from the seller panel.

Refer to the user guide to know more about the Seller and Customer Badge.

Seller Time Slot Management

Multi-Vendor Marketplace for Shopify is here with another featured app called Seller Time Slot Management.

Using this feature app seller and admin can manage opening and closing time for the seller’s store. This is a great way to make your customers aware of the seller’s availability.

This feature will have an additional charge of USD 5 per month over & above your current Multivendor Marketplace plan charges.

User Guide

SELLER BUYER CHAT CONNECTOR

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace SELLER BUYER CHAT CONNECTOR feature is here.

To know more about this feature, refer the USER GUIDE.

SOCIAL MEDIA LOGIN

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Social Media Login feature is here.

Through this sellers can log in to their Multivendor Marketplace seller panel using Gmail and Facebook accounts.

Admin can enable this feature with an additional charge of USD 10 per month over and above your selected Multivendor plan.

To know more about this feature, refer the USER GUIDE.

EMAIL MARKETING

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace EMAIL MARKETING feature is here.

If you are planning to send bulk emails to sellers manually, and want to create an email campaign for your sellers then this marketplace featured app is for you.

Using this email marketing featured app you can connect klaviyo account with your multivendor marketplace app and your seller profiles will transfer to your klaviyo account also.

Admin can enable this feature with an additional charge of USD 5 per month over and above your selected Multivendor plan.

To know more about this feature, refer the USER GUIDE.

WHATSAPP INTEGRATION

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace WHATSAPP INTEGRATION feature is here.

Now admin can send Automated WhatsApp Notification to sellers and customers.

As well for order placed, order fulfilled, order refund, order cancelled, and many more.

Charges: This will cost an additional 15 USD per month over & above your current Multivendor Marketplace plan.

To know more about this feature, refer the USER GUIDE.

MARKETPLACE PRODUCT FEATURE APPS

Here is the list of all the product add-ons available for the marketplace:-

Global Product

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Global Product feature is here.

It enables the store owner to create “Global Product” on his/her end. These global products will be visible to the sellers in the Global Product Section.

The seller can sell that product just by clicking “Sell this Product” button.

Admin can view the detail of the sellers who has sold his global product.

Admin can enable this feature with an additional charge of USD 15 per month over and above your selected Multivendor plan.
To know more about this feature, refer the USER GUIDE.

Favorite Product/Seller

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Favorite Product/Seller.

Through this feature you can have your customers like your seller as well as your Products.

Also, the customer will get all the updates through email related to his liked seller whenever the seller adds any new product or make changes in the existing product.

Once you enable this feature, it will cost you 5 USD per month in addition to your current multivendor plan.
Go through its User Manual to know more about this feature.

Stock Management

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Stock Management feature enables the admin to manage the product stock from seller.

Here, the admin can track the shipment while sellers will have the choice to select who will fulfill the order.

Seller will send the fulfillment request for the same and the admin can either accept or reject the offer.

Once you enable this feature, you will add 10 USD per month over and above your current Multivendor plan.
Refer to this User Manual to know more about this feature.

Make An Offer

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace “Make an Offer” feature app is here.

Once you enable this feature, you can get the request quotes from the customer on some or all product pages of your store. Thus, you can contact your customer and pursue them for purchase.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 10 over and above your current multivendor plan.
To get all the details about this feature, do refer its User Guide.

Product Feed

With the help of Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Product Feed app, merchant can add products from different ecommerce platform into Shopify store.

Admin can enable this feature with an additional charge of USD 10 per month over and above your selected Multivendor plan.
To know more about this feature app, refer its USER GUIDE

Indian GST

We have introduced an “Indian GST” module in Shopify Multivendor Marketplace app. This feature enables the seller to declare the product price inclusive of GST along with the other taxes.

Seller can add GST details from his end which will reflect in the “Seller to customer” invoice section of the admin panel.

Important Note:– Once you enable this feature, no taxes can be levied at checkout. The seller needs to enter the product price inclusive of GST and other taxes.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 5 over and above your current multivendor plan.
Refer the USER GUIDE to get the details about Indian GST feature.

Product Expiry

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace “Product Expiry” feature app is here. You can enable this feature to set an expiry date on products while creating it.

The product gets expired on the set date and will no longer available on the frontend.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 5 over and above your current multivendor plan.
To get the details about this app, refer this User Guide.

Slot Pricing

Now Onwards, using Multivendor Marketplace App, admin can allow their sellers to add different product prices for different customers on the basis of Customer Tags.

Admin can set a quantity range and add price for each of these ranges while adding or editing any product.

NOTE:- Slot Pricing Feature App works only in case of Normal Products.

To get this app, admin needs to approve the charge of $10 USD per month over and above the current Multivendor Plan.
Click here to Explore the App.

Booking Product

Shopify Multivendor Marketplace Booking Product.

This feature enables both admin and the seller to present their product on frontend on the basis of booking. Both can create “booking product” and set the date slot for them.

Customer can request for booking which can be either confirmed or cancelled by the seller.

This feature has an additional monthly charge of USD 5 over and above your current multivendor plan.
To know more about this feature, do refer the Booking Product User Guide.

Daily Deals

Multivendor Marketplace for Shopify- Daily Deals will now allow the Admin to grant permission to Sellers so that they can also add deals on their products.

Moreover, this is a great way to draw customers and increase sales of your shop.
Explore!

Artist Product Design

Till now, the Admin was able to create/allow Sellers on his Multivendor Marketplace for Shopify, but now with the new Multivendor Marketplace feature app, Artist Product Design,

Admin can create/add Artists on his store and let them add designs for the products to sell.

If the Admin wants to sell products with designs from different Artists then he can do so by using this featured app.

This app comes at a cost of $10.00 per month.

Explore!

Product Auction for Sellers

You might have used the Product Auction app on your Shopify Store earlier but this time you will have this featured app available for your marketplace.

Using Multivendor Marketplace Product Auction for Seller feature app, You as an admin can enable your sellers to add auction on products, and thus, customers will bid on the product of their choice.

This integration is free of cost i.e. You will be charged only for the Multivendor app as per your opted plan.

SPONSORED PRODUCT

This feature app allows Admin to create plans for the Sellers so that they can promote their product on the Admin Shopify store.

Now you as an admin can promote your seller products on the Home page, Search, Product, and collection page.

Admin can easily create different packages for each of these sections and sellers can buy and use these accordingly.

You can get this feature app at a monthly subscription of $ 40 (USD) over & above your current multivendor app plan.

User Guide

SUBSCRIPTION

We have introduced an additional feature in our Multivendor Marketplace app for Shopify name “Subscription” Feature app which enables the Customers to subscribe to sellers as well as products.

You can get this feature app at a monthly subscription of $ 10 (USD) over & above your current multivendor app plan.

User Guide

CROWDFUNDING

The Multivendor Marketplace App is now integrated with the Crowd Funding App for Shopify. Allow sellers to add crowdfunding projects/campaigns and raise funds for the cause.

To use this feature, you need to install the Crowdfunding App on your Shopify store from the official Shopify app store.

The app will cost you $15/month.

User Guide

PREORDER INTEGRATION

PreOrder is a great approach to determine the product in high demand. You can allow pre-order on your marketplace products and earn even before the product release.

The Multi-vendor Marketplace app for Shopify is now integrated with the Pre-order Controller App.

Enabling the PreOrder feature app, you can auto-enable pre-order for the seller’s products soon after the items get out of stock.

Thus, customers can preorder products from your marketplace by paying the preorder amount.

User Guide

Delivery slot Management

Now, the Delivery Slot Management app is integrated with the very popular Multi-vendor Marketplace app for Shopify.

The app allows the merchants to add delivery method to the app, create slots for the customers for on-time deliveries and fixed-day deliveries.

Pay What You Want

Pay what you want (PWYW) also known as Value-for-Value model is a pricing strategy where buyers pay their desired amount for a given commodity.

A minimum (floor) price is set, and/or a suggested price may be indicated as guidance for the buyer.

Split Cart

Multivendor Marketplace module has come up with a featured app named Split Cart. It helps your buyers to have split carts during the checkout process.

This means that when the buyers will add multiple seller’s products to their cart, their cart will get split vendor-wise i.e. each cart will have a separate seller’s products.

Thus, buyers will have different products from various sellers in their cart but only one cart having single seller’s products will be validated at a time during checkout.

With this feature, the admin will have an easily manageable order process and thus, can have the separate orders of each seller’s products.

You can get the Split Cart feature app simply by paying an amount of $14 per month over and above your current multivendor plan.

Customer Order Management

You might be using the Multi-vendor Marketplace app on your Shopify store.

Till now, your customers had no option to manage orders on their own once they purchase any seller’s products.

Keeping this in mind, we have integrated the Customer Order Management App in the Multi-vendor Marketplace App.

Now, you can allow sellers to let customers manage orders. Sellers, on the other hand, update the order status from their respective seller panels.

You can enable the Customer Order Management Configuration tab from the COM Configuration & activate the option for customers to manage orders of their respective seller’s products.

Thus, customers can easily raise RMA (Return, Cancel or Exchange) request, invoice requests,

request the admin to change their shipping address, and reorder their previous purchase. Accordingly, the status will be updated in the app.

The app is FREE of cost but you have to pay for the integration that will cost you $15 USD/month over & above your current Multi-vendor App plan.

Hyperlocal Marketplace

Multi-Vendor Marketplace for Shopify is here with another feature app called Hyperlocal Marketplace.

In a hyperlocal marketplace, the merchant can restrict their service area to a particular geographical region.

Since the hyperlocal ecosystem is based on the ‘near me’ concept, this makes the delivery of services/goods in a very short span of time.

Moreover, the hyperlocal marketplace uses the geographical location detector for detecting the current location of the customer.

It further scans the nearest registered service providers (vendors). Therefore, making the services a faster solution in terms of delivery!
